<rss version="2.0"><channel><title>Public audit fixture</title><item><title>Cloudflare CLI - Send feedback from the Cloudflare CLI and MCP</title><link>https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-11-23-agent-feedback/</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-11-23-agent-feedback/</guid><description><p>Send bug reports, feature requests, and feedback about where you got stuck
directly to Cloudflare.</p>
<p>Sign in with <code>cf auth login</code> or set <code>CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN</code>, then use
<code>cf feedback</code> with a short note.</p>
<figure class="nb-code-figure" data-nb-lang="sh"><pre class="astro-code astro-code-themes github-light github-dark nb-shiki-c6xiwz" tabindex="0" data-language="sh" data-nb-lang="sh"><code><span class="line"><span class="nb-shiki-1t8gfj">cf</span><span class="nb-shiki-mdbnqw"> feedback</span><span class="nb-shiki-mdbnqw"> "The deploy output did not identify the selected environment"</span></span></code></pre></figure>
<p>Coding agents connected to the Cloudflare API Model Context Protocol (MCP)
server can use the <code>submit_feedback</code> tool. The tool requires a <code>message</code>,
<code>type</code>, and <code>impact</code>. It accepts optional details such as the task and the
expected and actual results. Both options return a submission ID you can share.</p>
<p>For examples and the diagnostic details included in CLI reports, refer to
<a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/cf/agent-feedback/">Agent feedback</a>.</p></description><pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 00:00:00 GMT</pubDate><product>Cloudflare CLI</product><category>Cloudflare CLI</category></item></channel></rss>
